title: Mr. Market Miscalculates
summary:
The slow economic growth would cause inflation to decline, and that would permit the Fed to start
lowering rates in 2023, leading to economic vigor and market gains. And things appeared to be on track for economic growth and further
stock market appreciation. On the other hand, corporate
profit margins continued to look good, and gains in productivity surprised to the upside.
